Superflex: healthy named QB1s are premium. Huntley is a hedge not a 55. Willis is a 28 GUESS SF2, not Allen. Formula Ward 45 is a floor artifact.
Half-PPR: WRs hold. Committee RBs cap unless they have a path to 15+ touches.
10-team benches are shallow. Do not pay a 2nd for a 4th RB. Depth pieces are leftovers.
Side getting the best player gives extra in 2-for-1 / 3-for-1.
Do not smash-sell a locked start (Lamar / Gibbs / Chase / Amon-Ra) or buy Saquon as a 70 because he has no tag.
Do not smash-sell Watson after 8-113 because of a broken-rib headline. 28 GUESS HOLD.
IR is a discount not a drop if the player was a starter (Pierce is an 8 FA skip, not a stash).
